## Motivation

The [Muse Spark Open Deployment section](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Meta/MuseSparkOpen#hw=b300&strategy=low-latency&quant=nvfp4) currently uses `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-muse-spark-open`. Point the NVIDIA deployment instructions to `lmsysorg/sglang:latest`.

## Modifications

- Update the shared deployment/playground image mapping for B300, GB300, B200, and H200.
- Update the NVIDIA `docker pull` example to match.

## Accuracy Tests

- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` — passed.
- `pre-commit run --files docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Meta/MuseSparkOpen.mdx docs/src/snippets/configs/meta-models/muse-spark.jsx` — passed.
- `mint validate` — passed.

- `git diff --check` — passed.
